info.name: Refinitiv LSEG DataScope Select REST API

description.content:
Internet-hosted OData REST API for programmatic access to global pricing, corporate actions, reference data, historical data, cross-reference, and entity data. It provides fully automated extraction workflows and batch processing capabilities for large-scale data retrieval from the DataScope Select platform.
